column3: Close to the Hebrew; “songs” is rendered “psalms.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and he made it” is rendered “for it was He who made it.”
“Let us bow down and let us kneel down” is rendered “let us worship and bow down.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the flock of his hand” is rendered “the sheep of His hand,” and “if you will listen to his voice” as “if you would hear His voice.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “as at” before “Meribah.”
NASB begins God’s speech here with quotation marks; “ancestors” is rendered “fathers.”
NASB adds “For” and renders “a generation” as “that generation.”
“That I swore” is rendered “Therefore I swore,” and the oath formula “if they will go into my rest” as “Truly they shall not enter into My rest.”
